d:
The Rockets defeated the Hawks, 120-110 tonight in Houston. Alperen Sengun contributed a team-high 29 points to go with 9 rebounds 9 assists and 6 steals, with Kevin Durant of the Rockets adding an additional 22 points (6-13 FG, 1-4 3P). Jalen Johnson finished with a team-high 21 points along with 9 rebounds for the Hawks in the losing effort. The Rockets improve their record to 4-0 with the win, while the Hawks fall to 2-2 for the season
